design: PGR USB-C J9 to CP2102N U4

order.instruction: Explicitly select this stackup and ask JLCPCB to confirm 90 ohm differential impedance and geometry. Finished board thickness tolerance is not an impedance tolerance.

kicad_model_assumptions.solder_mask_note: Retained KiCad model approximation, not a JLCPCB process requirement. Manufacturer calculator uses its own solder mask model.
kicad_model_assumptions.loss_tangent_note: Retained project approximation, not a measured material specification.

usb_routing.structure: Differential pair, non-coplanar, with solder mask
usb_routing.limits_note: Mismatch and uncoupled limits are conservative project targets, not manufacturer limits.

delay_estimate.caution: Delay estimate uses simple microstrip effective permittivity, not coupled-line field solution. Geometry comes from manufacturer calculator. Existing routing is incomplete.

remaining_layout_actions: Move D4 and D5 next to J9 and finish both ESD signal connections with short ground paths.
Join J9 A6/B6 to D+ and A7/B7 to D- immediately at the connector.
Reroute existing USB copper using the new netclass dimensions.
Keep both signals on F.Cu above continuous In1.Cu GND. Avoid layer changes and ground plane gaps.
Keep unrelated routing at least 0.3 mm away where practical and top copper pours about 0.5 mm away; closer coplanar copper requires impedance recalculation.
Tune pair skew only if mismatch exceeds 1 mm, refill planes, run DRC, and validate enumeration and sustained transfers in both plug orientations.
validation_status: KiCad 10.0.6 reopened the class and accepted custom rules. Existing USB copper violates new geometry constraints and ESD connections are incomplete. Board is not fabrication-ready.
